youtube.title: AI Dashboard Looks Right. The Total Is Wrong.
youtube.description:
AI dashboard audit: check the data before the chart.
Free audit prompt + practice kit: https://withhammad.com/resources/ai-dashboard-data-check

This fictional orders file totals AED 15,000 because one AED 3,000 order appears twice. After reviewing that exact duplicate, six orders total AED 12,000.

Check the unit of each row, repeated IDs, currency and date range. Preserve the original and reconcile the totals. Repeated IDs can be legitimate line items: never delete them blindly.

Sample data, not client results. AI presenter.

Get the audit prompt and practice kit above. Subscribe for more practical AI builds.

#AIDashboard #DataQuality #Shorts
